# Spider Math

> Spider Math is an interactive mathematics educational platform and studio directed by Eng. Heba Abdel-Wahab (Heba Ayad), specialized in Egyptian National Curriculum (Thanweya Amma), American Diploma (Digital SAT, EST, ACT), and British Curriculum (IGCSE & A-Levels).

Spider Math provides interactive coursework, diagnostic skill quizzes, video lectures, Desmos-powered graphing workflows, and structured revision plans for high school and preparatory students.

## Curricula & Modules
- [Egyptian Curriculum (Thanweya Amma)](https://spider-math.com/curriculum/egyptian): Comprehensive coverage of Algebra, Solid Geometry, Calculus, Dynamics, and Statics with exam past papers.
- [American Diploma (Digital SAT & ACT)](https://spider-math.com/curriculum/american): Heart of Algebra, Problem Solving and Data Analysis, Passport to Advanced Math, and Desmos speed techniques.
- [British Curriculum (IGCSE & A-Levels)](https://spider-math.com/curriculum/british): Cambridge and Edexcel math modules covering Core, Extended, and Further Mathematics.
- [Gulf & Saudi Curriculum (Qudurat & Tahsili)](https://spider-math.com/curriculum/saudi): Quantitative section mastery, mental arithmetic, and intensive question banks.

## Platform Features & Tools
- [Diagnostic Assessment Engine](https://spider-math.com/placement-test): Free intelligent skill evaluation diagnosing strengths and weaknesses to produce a targeted learning path.
- [Interactive Topics & Knowledge Directory](https://spider-math.com/topics): Curated index of key math concepts, formula sheets, and solved problems.

## Contact & Teacher Information
- [About Eng. Heba Abdel-Wahab](https://spider-math.com/about): Teacher biography, academic engineering credentials, and student success track record.
